# On targets without the inline bump sequence, constant-size noscan
# arena.New calls the region slow path and never the bump helper.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosarena
env CGO_ENABLED=0
env GOARCH=386

cd m
logos build -o slow386.exe .
go tool objdump -s 'main\.regionNew8' slow386.exe
stdout 'logosRegionAllocNoscan'
! stdout 'logosRegionBump'
go tool objdump -s 'main\.regionNew512' slow386.exe
stdout 'logosRegionAllocNoscan'
! stdout 'logosRegionBump'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/regionslowpath386

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "logos/arena"

var regionSink int

type regionPad512 [512]byte

//go:noinline
func regionUse(p *int) int {
	*p++
	return *p
}

//go:noinline
func regionNew8() int {
	{
		r := arena.Open()
		p := arena.New[int](r)
		return regionUse(p)
	}
}

//go:noinline
func regionNew512() int {
	{
		r := arena.Open()
		p := arena.New[regionPad512](r)
		p[0] = 1
		return int(p[511])
	}
}

func main() {
	regionSink += regionNew8()
	regionSink += regionNew512()
	_ = regionSink
}
